# Fixture provenance

Every fixture checked into `test/fixtures/` MUST appear in this table. Origin
and scrubbing matter for OSS license cleanliness and are impossible to
reconstruct after the fact.

When you add a fixture:

1. Add one row below. Keep paths relative to `test/fixtures/`.
2. State the **source**: who created the file, with what tool. "Hand-authored"
   is acceptable for minimal fixtures.
3. State the **license**: MIT / CC0 / your own / etc. If the file is a
   template downloaded from somewhere, that source's license applies.
4. State any **scrubbing** done: PII removed, brand-specific content swapped,
   embedded media replaced with public-domain stand-ins. "None" if untouched.
5. State the **feature(s) targeted** in one short phrase — what is this
   fixture supposed to exercise?

| Path | Source | License | Scrubbing | Targets |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `minimal/blank.pptx` | Generated by `minimal/generate.py` via vendored `references/python-pptx` (v1.0.2). | python-pptx default template — MIT. | None — content is python-pptx's default empty document. | OPC round-trip: a real PPTX with 13 parts, a slide master, layouts, and a theme. |
| `minimal/one-text-slide.pptx` | Same as above; script adds one slide with a title shape. | MIT (python-pptx). | None. | OPC round-trip with a populated text placeholder. |
| `minimal/two-slides.pptx` | Same as above; script adds two slides with title + body. | MIT (python-pptx). | None. | OPC round-trip with multiple slides. |
| `minimal/one-image-slide.pptx` | Same as above; script adds one title and a 100×100 PNG via Pillow's `Image.new`. | MIT (python-pptx + Pillow); generated solid-color image. | None — no original image bytes were imported. | L2 image-replacement round-trip; picture-shape classification. |
| `minimal/layout-decoration.pptx` | Derived from a generated blank deck; a generator script injected non-placeholder decoration: a picture logo (synthetic 32×32 solid-green PNG) + a rounded "TEMPLATE" bar into the slide layout, and a footer bar into the slide master. | MIT (python-pptx base); generated solid-color PNG. | None — synthetic content only, no third-party assets. | `getSlideLayoutShapes` / `getSlideMasterShapes`: reading + rendering template decoration, incl. a layout picture whose bytes resolve via the layout's rels. |
| `pptxgenjs/combo.pptx` | Generated with pptxgenjs 4.0.1 (`addChart` column + line, `secondaryValAxis` / `secondaryCatAxis`, axis titles and label fonts). | MIT (pptxgenjs); generated content only. | None — synthetic labels A/B/C and numbers. | Reader / builder round trip of a real pptxgenjs combo chart: line markers and `smooth`, secondary axis by plot-group reference, `<c:grouping>` per group, unrotated axis title. |
| `pptxgenjs/doughnut.pptx` | Generated with pptxgenjs 4.0.1 (`addChart` doughnut with `showValue` / `showPercent`, data-label font and format). | MIT (pptxgenjs); generated content only. | None. | Series-level `<c:dLbls>` plus per-point `<c:dLbl>` overrides and `<c:dPt>` colors on a real pptxgenjs doughnut. |
| `pptxgenjs/bar-secondary.pptx` | Generated with pptxgenjs 4.0.1 (`addChart` horizontal bar + bar with `secondaryValAxis`). | MIT (pptxgenjs); generated content only. | None. | Horizontal bar axis positions (`l` / `b` / `r` / `b`) and secondary-axis detection on a real pptxgenjs deck. |
| `pptxgenjs/text-table.pptx` | Generated with pptxgenjs 4.0.1 (`addText` with three runs incl. a raw CR LF run, `addTable` with `autoPage` and two runs in one cell). | MIT (pptxgenjs); generated content only. | None. | Mixed-format runs read from a pptxgenjs text box / table cell and rewritten via `setShapeParagraphs` / `setTableCellParagraphs`; raw CR LF in `<a:t>` reads as LF. |
